flux_duo.accuracy: O(h) on a quasi-uniform icosahedral triangular mesh
flux_duo.reference: Heikes et al. (2023), J. Adv. Model. Earth Syst. 15:e2022MS003192 (DUO icosahedral triangular C-grid); the edge-normal advective flux of a transported scalar — the building block that divergence_duo integrates to form advection_duo. flux(U,q)_e = U[e] · (q[faces_on_edge[e,1]] + q[faces_on_edge[e,2]])/2, the prescribed edge-normal mass-flux velocity U[e] times the second-order centered reconstruction of q at edge e from its two incident triangles. This is an edge-OUTPUT arrayop (free index over edges, gathering the two incident cells via faces_on_edge, written as a reduction over the two faces s∈{1,2} with weight 1/2), the same edge-output form as gradient_duo. The edge reconstruction is the un-summed integrand of advection_duo's flux divergence: div(U·q) = (1/tri_area) Σ_k edge_sign_on_face · dc_edge · flux(U,q). U is a build-time prescribed edge field; only q and U reach the per-step hot tree.
